## 1. Executive Summary
Faruk Hasan is a Senior AI Test Automation Engineer, SDET, and STEM Educator with over 6+ years of specialized experience in software quality engineering, test automation frameworks, and modern artificial intelligence evaluation. He holds a Master of Science in Electrical Engineering from Loyola Marymount University (Los Angeles, CA) and a Bachelor of Engineering in Electrical and Electronic Engineering from Queen Mary University of London (United Kingdom).

Faruk bridges cutting-edge AI technologies—such as LLM evaluation frameworks (DeepEval), LLM-as-a-judge methodologies, and autonomous Agentic AI workflows with Model Context Protocol (MCP)—with enterprise-scale quality engineering and continuous delivery pipelines (Playwright, TeamCity, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

---

## 2. Professional Experience

### Senior Software QA Engineer — Digital.ai
*Location: Remote | Duration: September 2022 – Present*
- **LLM Evaluation & Quality Benchmarking**: Pioneered AI evaluation strategies using **DeepEval**, implementing **LLM-as-a-judge** architectures with G-Eval metrics (measuring hallucination, faithfulness, answer relevancy, and bias) to benchmark enterprise generative AI response quality.
- **Agentic AI & Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: Designed and evaluated autonomous agentic workflows by integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers (including Playwright MCP), enabling AI agents to autonomously execute multi-step browser automation and end-to-end regression workflows.
- **AI-Assisted Development**: Leveraged AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude) to accelerate test creation, scenario generation, and maintenance across enterprise web platforms.
- **Playwright Test Architecture**: Architected and scaled a modular Playwright framework in TypeScript covering 300+ automated test cases, reducing regression cycle times by **50%**.
- **Continuous Quality Gates**: Engineered automated testing quality gates in **TeamCity** and **Jenkins**, guaranteeing fast feedback and reliable releases for cloud platforms.
- **Engineering Leadership**: Mentored junior QA engineers on Page Object Model (POM) design patterns, data-driven testing, and mitigation of flaky tests.

### Software Test Engineer — M.M. Hayes Co., Inc.
*Location: Albany, NY | Duration: March 2020 – August 2022*
- **Selenium Automation**: Developed and maintained automated regression suites using **Selenium WebDriver**, **Java**, and **TestNG** for core enterprise workflows.
- **Database & Backend Validation**: Wrote complex **SQL queries** to validate transactional integrity, stored procedures, and back-end database state.
- **Mobile & Hardware Testing**: Executed cross-platform automated mobile testing with **Appium** across iOS, Android, and Point of Sale (POS) hardware devices.
- **Agile Quality Process**: Authored test strategies, test plans, and traceability matrices in Jira to ensure 100% requirements coverage.

## 6. Notable Projects & Open Source
